description: Reads a file: text, the text of PDFs and documents (Word, RTF, HTML), or an image, which is shown. Long text comes in parts; pass offset to read on. A PDF without text (a scan) is shown as a picture of a page; offset picks the page (from 0).

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

offset.description: Start at this character, from a previous answer

name: files_read
title: Read a File
